Jonathan's got a good relationship with them in New York. I don't want to say it's impossible because again, other companies have done it and they've done it for the purpose of selling the data.
So I feel like for us, using it for personal use won't necessarily be an insurmountable hurdle. Secondary issue, but definitely... I do mean secondary is as far as the upfront cost of the implementation, I think it's a little bit steep for Jonathan's tastes.
If there were a way to maybe rate it out over the term of the contract, I think it would be a lot easier for him to swallow that pill.

content.text:

It's definitely something we can solve, and we've been trying to figure out how we're going to do this for a while. That's something we could do. I don't know if we necessarily want to have that many moving parts.

If I had six hours every day to work on this, I would probably work on this six hours a day.

content.text:

content.text: It has been...

content.speaker: Speaker 2

content.speaker: Speaker 3
content.text: Absolutely. And I appreciate how much work and creativity you guys have put into this. It's, you know, I've been very impressed with the entire team, and I'm sorry that it has not been easier to work with us. I swear, we try our very best to be to work with.

content.speaker: Speaker 2
content.text:

content.speaker: Speaker 3
content.text: Right? Absolutely. You guys all enjoy your weekend as well. Thank you so much for...
